title: NHK World — 日本の伝統工芸 (Japanese Traditional Crafts)
description: NHK World spotlights four Japanese traditional crafts through visits to artisan workshops: Arita porcelain (佐賀), Wajima lacquerware (石川), Echizen washi paper (福井), and Awa indigo dyeing (徳島). Introduces craft vocabulary and the philosophy of monozukuri (the art of making things).
creator: NHK World Japan
license: © NHK World Japan — free streaming educational content
